name: Sunsama
tagline: Calm daily planner that unifies tasks, calendar, and intentional planning.
description: Sunsama is a daily planner that pulls tasks from tools like Asana, Trello, Jira, and email into one workspace, then walks you through planning a realistic day alongside your calendar. It emphasizes focus mode with Pomodoro timers, daily shutdown rituals, and time analytics over feature sprawl.
insight: Came out of Y Combinator's W19 batch and stayed small and profitable rather than chasing large rounds.

modelSupport.notes: AI features are assistive; the product centers on structured manual planning rather than an LLM agent.

edge: Guided plan-and-shutdown ritual instead of auto-scheduling — calm intentional planning over throughput maximizing.
pros: Pulls tasks from Asana, Jira, Trello, email
Built-in focus timers and time analytics
cons: Manual planning won't suit auto-schedule fans
